constraints.database: fresh database per validator, booted once, then npm run seed; nothing else pre-loaded
constraints.accounts: scripts/create-test-member.mjs: member@test.local and the admin, platform and career terms accepted (--no-terms only for steps that test terms)
constraints.browser: the pinned Chromium named in the release-loop args; no other browser
constraints.fixtures: only the fixtures written in the spec and its appendices, created through the UI unless a precondition says otherwise

steps.summary: Log in.
Career Master → **Manual Intake**: add
Have at least one output in **Resume Output History** (import one, or generate one).
Open Proficiency & Rollups → click **3 · Rules & why**.
In **Levels and why**, find **Ledgerly ERP**.
Expect an amber banner above the table: "**2 technologies need a proficiency category** (Ledgerly ERP, QuoteFlow CPQ)…", and under each of those tools' dropdown
In **Levels and why**, Ledgerly ERP row, column **How it was used**, choose **Integration design**.
Open Career Master → **Manual Intake** → Tools → Ledgerly ERP.
In **Levels and why**, row **Forecast modeling** (13 years + 4 = 17 pts → Expert), column **Your override**, choose **Advanced**.
To undo, choose **Use formula** in the same dropdown.
In **Certification bonuses**, click **+ Add certification bonus**.
Choose certification **Ledgerly Certified Consultant**, bonus points **3**, keep "Count even if lapsed" ticked, click chip **Ledgerly ERP · tool** (it turns dar
Click **Delete** on that bonus and confirm.
In **Formula in use**, on the Salt Basin methodology row click **Duplicate**.
Change the *Cap* on **Years performed** to **10**; change the *Minimum points* for **Expert** to **12**. Click **Save and use this formula**.
Click the **Salt Basin methodology** radio.
Try to edit the methodology: click **View** — expect "(read-only)" and no inputs.
Make sure one tool still has no category (e.g. QuoteFlow CPQ).
Open **My Resume → Resume Output History**.
On any output click **Approve for QR** (or **Approve** / **Publish**) and confirm.
Choose **Hands-on**, click **Save to Career Master and continue**.
Open the output's link `/r/<slug>` (or scan its QR code) in a private window.
Back in Career Master, change a job title (Manual Intake → Jobs) and save. Wait ~3 seconds. Reload the QR page.
Use the slider **Data timeline — slide from the printed version to live**: drag to the far left.
On a chart click **Salt particles**: expect grains falling into columns, settling with a gold line and value on top; hover a column → tooltip with its name and
Set a tool category or override a level, wait ~3 seconds, reload — expect the change listed (e.g. "Changed: Ledgerly ERP — printed Advanced · Integration design
World Shell (`/world`) -> **Output Templates** island (title "Output Templates"). Open or create a template so the editor with the live preview opens.
Click **Rules & why**.
On the Infographics tab make sure the Proficiency chart is in the template (add it if it is not), then override one level by hand (as Journey 3, step 1-2); the
At 390px wide, expect the tab row to wrap and **Rules & why** to stay reachable, and the whole editor (presets, Preset Info, tab content, preview) to stack in a
Add a fictional tool with no category (Career Master → Manual Intake → Tools, name Fiscalis TMS). Then open **My Resume → Resume Output History**, click **Appro
Empty Career Master: Rules & why shows "No skills or tools yet — add them in Career Master → Manual Intake."; QR page shows no charts section.
A link that was revoked or never approved: QR page shows "This link isn't available".
Saving a formula with an unknown input or no thresholds: error toast, nothing saved.
Editing or deleting the Salt Basin methodology via the API: refused (403).
